# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, well-supported foundation
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package installations
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes
# - Disable OpenIB BTL to avoid warnings/errors in environments without InfiniBand.
# - Force TCP communication over the primary container network interface (eth0).
# - Address potential shared memory issues within containers.
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=^openib
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_include=eth0
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none

# Install dependencies, clone, build, and clean up in a single layer to optimize image size.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    cmake \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    wget \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libfftw3-dev \
    libgomp1 \
    gfortran \
    # FIX: Add Python, which is a build-time dependency for LAMMPS's cmake configuration
    python3 \
    python3-dev && \
    #
    # Clone the latest branch of the LAMMPS source code
    git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/lammps/lammps.git /opt/lammps-src && \
    cd /opt/lammps-src && \
    #
    # Configure the build with CMake, enabling the REAXFF package and MPI support
    mkdir build && cd build && \
    cmake ../cmake \
        -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
        -D BUILD_MPI=yes \
        -D PKG_REAXFF=on && \
    #
    # Compile LAMMPS using all available processor cores
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    #
    # Copy the main LAMMPS executable to a system-wide location on the PATH
    cp lmp /usr/local/bin/lmp && \
    #
    # Create the application working directory
    mkdir -p /app && \
    #
    # Copy the required example files into the working directory
    cp /opt/lammps-src/examples/reaxff/HNS/* /app/ && \
    #
    # Clean up to reduce final image size
    # Remove source code and build artifacts
    rm -rf /opt/lammps-src && \
    #
    # Uninstall build-time dependencies
    apt-get purge -y --auto-remove \
        build-essential \
        cmake \
        git \
        wget \
        libopenmpi-dev \
        libfftw3-dev \
        gfortran \
        # FIX: Remove Python development packages after build
        python3 \
        python3-dev && \
    #
    # Clear apt cache
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set the default working directory for the container
WORKDIR /app

# This manifest defines a Flux Framework MiniCluster for a LAMMPS HPC application.
# It is configured to run a specific LAMMPS experiment on a single pod within a Kubernetes cluster.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A unique name for the MiniCluster resource.
  name: lammps-reax-experiment
  # The Kubernetes namespace where this MiniCluster will be deployed.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods in the MiniCluster.
  # Set to 1 to run the entire job on a single node.
  size: 1

  # The total number of tasks (e.g., MPI ranks) to run across the MiniCluster.
  tasks: 1

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Enforces strict schema validation for this CRD, failing on unknown fields.
    strict: true

  # When set to false, the MiniCluster pods and services are not deleted after the job completes,
  # which is useful for debugging and inspecting logs.
  cleanup: false

  # Defines the container(s) that will run within the MiniCluster.
  containers:
    - # The specific container image to be used for the LAMMPS experiment.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax

      # The command to execute inside the container.
      # The Flux Operator automatically prepends "flux run" to this command.
      # This command runs the LAMMPS reaxff simulation for HNS.
      command: lmp -v x 2 -v y 2 -v z 2 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite

      # When set to false, this container is a worker that participates in the Flux job.
      # It is not solely dedicated to launching the job.
      launcher: false

# Fix: Corrected the flux-view container image for the selected ARM architecture.
# The previous manifest failed because the default flux-view image tag did not support ARM.
# This version explicitly sets spec.flux.container.image to an ARM-compatible tag
# to resolve the ImagePullBackOff error, as identified in the failure analysis.
# The application command is also reset to the requested testing parameters.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: lammps-reax-experiment
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods in the MiniCluster.
  # Set to 1 to run the entire job on a single node.
  size: 1
  # The total number of tasks (e.g., MPI ranks) to run across the MiniCluster.
  # Set to 64 to utilize all cores of the target hpc7g.16xlarge instance.
  tasks: 64
  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    strict: true
  # When set to false, the MiniCluster pods are not deleted after the job completes.
  cleanup: false
  # Pod-level specifications for the MiniCluster pods.
  pod:
    # Ensures the MiniCluster pods are scheduled on nodes with the specified instance type.
    # hpc7g.16xlarge are AWS Graviton (ARM) instances optimized for HPC workloads.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: "hpc7g.16xlarge"
  # Flux-specific configuration.
  flux:
    # Specify the target architecture for the Flux pods.
    arch: arm
    # FIX: Explicitly set the container image for the Flux sidecar (flux-view).
    # This is required for ARM architectures as the default tag does not support it.
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9
  # Defines the container that will run the application within the MiniCluster.
  containers:
    - # The main application container for the LAMMPS experiment.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
      # The command to execute, updated to the specified testing command.
      # The Flux Operator will prepend "flux run -n 64" to this.
      command: lmp -v x 2 -v y 2 -v z 2 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite
      # This container is a worker, not a dedicated launcher.
      launcher: false
